crop.notes: Clipping from 'Sporting Notes' stops mid-line after 'free concert every even-'; the rest of the Allen notice is cut off. Also includes an unrelated cricket item.

ocr.notes: Transcript is garbled; only 'retired champion pugiliat of the' is recognizable.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat carried a sporting note for Tom Allen, retired champion pugilist of the world, at 619 Market Street, offering a free concert every evening.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, June 24, 1893, page 7.

facts.fact: Allen, styled retired champion pugilist of the world, ran a saloon at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, with free concerts every evening

notes: Same notice as article 892 (1893-07-08), which shows the full text.
